description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for applying patches in a Git repository. It uses commands like git apply, git diff, and others to verify patch application behavior under various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a command to be run after the test finishes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks if a file is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path is missing.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specific lines to a file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the repository timestamp for test purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
